title: Parent-child retrievers (hierarchical chunking/retrieval)
keyFindings: Parent-child retrieval decouples the indexing unit (small child chunks for precise, high-recall retrieval) from the context unit (the larger parent chunk/document returned to the generator). It is a mature, open pattern (LangChain ParentDocumentRetriever, LlamaIndex auto-merging/sentence-window/recursive, Haystack AutoMergingRetriever) with four variants differing in how 'parent' is defined.

Astrographer's contract already has the natural parent/child split: a Document (astrographer.md §4.1.1) is the parent and its content/fact/reference nodes (§4.2.1) are the children; Incanter's spring-tension dynamic chunking (incanter.md §4.6) is the child-generation mechanism. A parent-child mode on ragQuery/ragStream (§4.3.2) would expand a retrieved child to its parent Document/subgraph before generation.

The fact/reference model makes a narrow MUST-adjacent case: retrieving a reference/embed child should expand to the canonical fact and its owning document (astrographer.md §4.2.3), honoring the STALE marker — the same reasoning that made exact factKey retrieval a narrow MUST in hybrid-search-research-notes.md.

Zodiac's pre-graphing + vector-embedding pipeline (zodiac.md §4.2) has the same two-level structure; a parent expansion on zodiac_query (§4.3.2) would return the parent graph/document for a matched embedded item, carrying the stale flag (§6.11).

The technique is fully D2-compliant (local ingestion-time index + query-time expansion, reusing the local Ollama embedding leg), D1-compliant (open pattern, no licensing constraint), and D4-compliant if exposed as a query parameter on both GUI and MCP (rag_query/rag_stream, zodiac_query).

The cleanest home for the engine-side parent expansion is inside Incanter's POST /v1/query (incanter.md §4.8) so Astrographer's ragQuery stays a single call — an Incanter handoff (docs/defects.md GAP-1 pattern), not a patch from this repo.
summary: Parent-child retrieval (hierarchical chunking/small-to-big) indexes small child chunks for precise retrieval but returns the larger parent chunk/document as context, fixing the small-chunk-vs-big-context trade-off. It maps cleanly onto Astrographer's Document/node model and Zodiac's pre-graphing pipeline, is fully local-first (D2) and open (D1), and must be exposed on both GUI and MCP for D4 parity. Recommended SHOULD, with a narrow MUST-adjacent slice for Astrographer's fact/reference resolution to the canonical source of truth.
